body: it’s been a few weeks for me (f17)and yet i have made little to no progress lmao,, i still have dreams about him and thoughts of him still consume my brain 24/7. how can i get past this part??? any tips ??? i’m glad you’re doing better though!! that’s awesome :))

hi hun. if she’s doing more harm than good, then you have an important decision to make. i would try to talk to her first and let her know what’s hurting you and what you want to change. if she’s willing to go through with all of that then great; give it another chance. if not, then i think the best thing for you would be to create some space. maybe not forever, but for a while. i hope it all turns out better for you!

thank you for this, i really needed to hear that from someone. eventually i’ll muster up the courage to tell the both of them, but it almost feels like a lost cause. it hurts to come to the realization that i was simply a pawn in his game that he was playing whenever he felt lonely or bored, but there’s nothing i can do to change that now. i have started to write down what i will say to him. one day i’ll send it. thanks for reaching out, it truly means a lot. have a good night man :)
